decisions.reason: A burner component that extends the established radiant heater line costs little to carry, and its value is still uncertain, so the option is worth keeping.
The electric infrared panel heater has its own page and fits the electrification trend, so with demand still unresolved it is a cheap option on lower-carbon heating.
The halogen infrared heater sits next to the core range and costs little to keep listed, and no evidence yet shows its value will not be realized.
The industrial electric hall heater is close to the core business and matches the move to electric, lower-carbon heating, so keeping it is cheap and promising.
The hydrogen-capable dark infrared heater is a strategic option on hydrogen-ready heating whose value is still uncertain, and it already shows early real-world operation.
